name: smartschool-mcp
description: Courses, grades, planner, tasks, messages and documents from Smartschool.
long_description:
Lets Claude read your Smartschool portal: the timetable and planner (tests, assignments, what to bring), results with the teacher's feedback, messages and their attachments, course documents and leerpaden, notes and absences from the pupil file.

Claude only reads. Nothing is sent, answered or changed in Smartschool.

Set up: fill in your school's Smartschool address, your username and password, and the answer to Smartschool's extra verification (a birth date, or a 2FA secret). Your credentials stay on your computer; what Claude looks up appears in your conversation.

tools.name: get_courses
tools.description: Retrieve all available courses with their teachers.
